scope: Studio equipment inventory, crafting and presentation; no UE migration
cause: Crafting added, replaced or removed explicit affixes while copying the old rarity field. The bag, equipped row and tooltip then displayed that stale field, including a four-affix common staff.

policy.rare: 3 or more random affixes; ordinary drop generation remains 3–6 and existing crafting counts remain supported
policy.legendary: A real legendary or extraLegendary fixed payload takes priority over random-affix count
policy.excluded: Inherent bases, a bound active skill and children within one composite affix do not increase the explicit affix count
policy.unidentified: Keep committed drop quality until actual values are generated

fix.transactions: Generation, replacement, append, removal, rerolling, ground equipment creation and pickup update quality metadata.
fix.legacy: cleanPlayerInventory repairs existing instances after unavailable-affix cleanup; preset application stages corrected metadata before committing.
fix.presentation: Inventory projections, equipped cells, tooltip labels and frames, and equipment documents share the derived quality.
fix.content: Meteor, wish and annulment currency descriptions explain quality changes rather than promising to retain stale quality.
fix.preservation: Correction changes only rarity metadata: no reroll of bases or explicit/fixed affixes, bound skill, item UID or numeric values. Combat rule VM and damage resolver unchanged.

verification.mainCommand: node --test tests/equipment-rarity.test.mjs tests/equipment.test.mjs tests/crafting-grades.test.mjs tests/quad-affix-orb.test.mjs tests/equipment-crafting-categories.test.mjs tests/inventory-ground.test.mjs
verification.additionalNote: The seventh case, added after the main run, verifies stale-quality equipment through dropping and pickup.
browserCases: four legacy qualities repaired on production page load
equipped rare staff matches tooltip and frame
actual meteor UI promotes common to rare
actual removal UI transitions rare to magic to common
verification.unrelatedFailure: equipment-bases.test.mjs:17 hard-codes 69 authored base templates; the current library contains 101. No template count or base type was changed by this fix.
